title: What’s next for interoception and addiction?
title_zh: 内感受觉与成瘾研究的下一步是什么？
abstract: Interoception is the perception of internal stimuli and is tightly coupled to the development of aberrant motivation to consume pharmacological reinforcers characteristic of addiction. We review the current theoretical basis of the role of interoception in addiction, candidate neurobiological mechanisms underlying interoception of drugs, and the place of interoception in the broader theoretical understanding of addiction. Broadly, interoceptive drug stimuli acquire control over appetitive behaviour by functioning as conditioned stimuli, discriminative stimuli, and occasion setters and these processes may involve activation of the insula and modulation of mesolimbic dopamine neurons. Notably, the interoceptive stimulus characteristics and reinforcing characteristics of drugs are distinct in their independence on sensitization and tolerance. Directions for future work on the role of interoception in addiction are discussed.
abstract_zh: 内感受觉是对体内刺激的感知，与成瘾特征之一——异常的药物强化动机行为发展密切相连。我们回顾了内感受觉在成瘾中的理论基础、药物内感受觉的候选神经生物学机制，以及内感受觉在成瘾总体理论框架中的地位。总体而言，药物的内感受觉刺激可通过条件刺激、辨别刺激和情境信号发生器作用于奖赏行为，其中可能涉及岛叶的激活及中脑边缘系统多巴胺神经元的调节。值得注意的是，药物的内感受觉属性和强化属性在敏化和耐受性依赖上彼此独立。文中还讨论了内感受觉在成瘾中的作用未来研究方向。
